findings.message: 6 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "HECHO CADA DÍA · CON EL CORAZÓN · S" → 3 lines (9 words, 40px); "Repostería recién hecha, pensada para ti." → 3 lines (6 words, 103.7px); "«En Selecta, cada postre está hecho con el coraz" → 4 lines (34 words, 57.6px, a paragraph set above 36px); "La diferencia está en lo que no se ve" → 3 lines (9 words, 76.8px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 13 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 11 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Obrador artesanal · Torrejón de Ardoz" above "Repostería recién hecha, pensada para ti"; "La colección" above "Creaciones para cada ocasión"; "Cómo funciona" above "Del obrador a tu mesa, sin complicacione"; "Encargos a medida" above "Diseña tu tarta, a tu manera"; "Selecta para empresas" above "Repostería a la altura de tu marca"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 54 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Elaborado cada mañana en Torrejón de Ard", "✦", "✦", "Opciones sin gluten y sin lactosa").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✦
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 4 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.hero-thumb → rgba(43, 33, 29, 0.45) 0px 30px 60px -30px | div.seal → rgba(43, 33, 29, 0.5) 0px 20px 50px -25px | div.stamp → rgba(43, 33, 29, 0.45) 0px 30px 60px -30px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 32 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): dl.hero-facts 589px | div.marquee 1440px | div.steps 1208px | div.step.reveal 302px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 11 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #fbf8f3, section #f4ece2, section #fbf8f3).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Sabores" 3.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "Alérgenos" 3.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "Entrega" 3.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "Confirmar" 3.1:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 15.5px.
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.4:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 27 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.
